description: Permissions of the main window: the key-value store and opening http(s) links in the system browser (release page of a new version). No dialog:* or fs:* permission (0.12): the backup export/import goes through the app's own commands guardar_fichero_elegido / abrir_fichero_elegido (src/lib.rs), which show the dialog and touch only the chosen file, because tauri-plugin-fs opens file:// and content:// URLs without checking its scope.
